items.claim: Lucas Fernando throws good technical sharp straight punches with no telegraph on the jab.
items.quote: he throws good technical sharp straight punches, man. That jab is right down the middle. There's no telegraph on it.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando works the body incredibly well and does not just headhunt on the regional scene.
items.quote: He works the body incredibly well. Whenever you see a guy that's on the regional scene, and he's not just headunting the whole time.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando is much better and more accurate on the feet than Tobias.
items.quote: Lucas Fernando to me is much better on the feet. Much better. What? Much more accurate.

items.claim: Tobias's striking defense is not there.
items.quote: Tobias's striking defense. It's not there.

items.claim: Raphael is too slow to be able to get a hold of Fernando consistently.
items.quote: I think Raphael is too slow to be able to get a hold of Fernando consistently.

items.claim: Vicente Luque looked fantastic against Kelvin Gastelum, throwing nasty counter shots and tagging him repeatedly.
items.quote: Vicente Luke looked fantastic against Kelvin Gastelum... Vicente Luke was throwing some nasty counter shots and tagging Kelvin Gastelum on the way in over and over and over again.
